bias.en: Uptrend · MACD crossed down, back at the 10 and 30-day
bias.zh: 上升趋势 · MACD 下穿，回到 10 和 30 日均线

read.en: Microsoft fell 2.2% on Nov 10 to $533.16, trading $526.36–544.15. It is above the 10-day ($531.2), 30-day ($529.7), 100-day ($475.5) and 200-day ($440.6) and below the 5-day ($540.1); all five averages are rising. MACD crossed below its signal on Nov 10, above zero; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 4 ($509.17), and RSI is 52.

The drop lost the $537.7–542.3 support (Oct 29 high, Nov 4 low, 5-day), now resistance, and the close sits on the 10 and 30-day ($529.7–531.2). Resistance is $540.1–544.2 (5-day, Nov 10 high), then $548.3–551.2 and $557.6–559.2 (52-week high). Support is $524.5–531.2 (10 and 30-day, Nov 6 and Nov 10 lows), then $505–509.2 (Nov 2 low, SAR). A close above $544.2 would target $548–551; below $524.5, $505–509.

r.en: 5-day average $540.1; Oct 29 high $541.29; Nov 4 low $542.30, lost; Nov 10 high $544.15

s.en: 10 and 30-day averages ($529.7–531.2); Nov 10 low $526.36; Nov 6 low $524.47
